expected: Idempotency dedupe is bounded: a repeated key inside its window replays the existing grant with no second mint and no second secret delivery, and once the key's window (or the grant) has passed a reuse is treated as a fresh request and a new grant is allowed.
observed: Same key sent twice replayed the identical grant_id 01M01K6F0VT82W831VHT5YCWDV (status active) with NO credentials on the second response (credential_redelivery=false) and NO second decision record (audit show shows exactly 1 grant_decision/1 access_key_id). A fresh idempotency key produced a distinct new active grant 01M01K7D5RPH6CHF2653A8QDR0 with credentials, exercising the exact created=true mint branch that a post-window reuse takes. The literal same-key post-window re-mint is governed by a hardcoded IdempotencyWindow=time.Hour (internal/broker/broker.go:45), independent of the 900s grant lifetime and not configurable; advancing the clock 1h, editing config, or restarting the broker are all forbidden in this read-only shared harness, so that single branch is confirmed structurally (PutIdempotencyKey replaces an expired row via ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE and returns created=true; DeleteExpiredIdempotencyKeys GCs closed windows) rather than by a wall-clock wait. No deviation from expected behavior was observed on any observable path.
